svg.title: Audit Defense and Negotiation Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-audit-negotiation-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Audit Defense and Negotiation Roadmap; subtitle: Leverage exists before signature; caption: Lock auditor terms, close license gaps, harden contract escalators and negotiate with a credible walk-away.; assumptions note: Weekly grouping is a sequencing frame only; practitioners cited 30-day respond and settle deadlines but no weekly schedule.; note: Sources: SAMexpert TV [7shzxv1SUFc @ 00:10:22, 00:18:31, 00:54:49, 01:09:04, 01:15:49]; SAMexpert TV [S-D4c7b8-94 @ 00:14:57]; Virtualization Options LLC [xP4R2F8hbBw @ 00:06:54]; Virtualization Options LLC [fTqBORy9ePo @ 00:03:00, 00:05:39]; Heartland Business Systems [jqaG0NHe-0c @ 00:00:57].; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Lock auditor kickoff terms; deliverable: Direct NDA signed with the auditor; nothing handed over, not even the org structure; gate: Written protocol of disagreement opened; week: Week 2; title: Close compliance gaps; deliverable: Per-user SPLA counts include everyone authorized through VNC, Guacamole or TeamViewer; gate: Non-compliance below 5 percent, avoiding licenses at 125 percent of the discounted price list plus $27k-$40k in audit fees; week: Week 3; title: Harden contract terms; deliverable: 3-5 percent annual escalator cap against 15-25 percent uncapped drift over three years; gate: Costed exit pilot complete, with discount sequenced last; week: Week 4; title: Negotiate or switch partner; deliverable: Microsoft talks timed to its June year-end; midterm CSP transfer tool ready if the partner offers no renewal help; gate: Walk-away position credible to the vendor
